carries: the offline product pack is built from two sources kept in two files, which is the licence and not tidiness
United States from USDA FoodData Central Branded Foods, public domain under CC0, nothing to comply with
Canada from Open Food Facts filtered on Canada, ODbL, attribution and share-alike on that file only
the pack carries printed ingredient text and derives no allergens: a frozen reading on a safety path is worse than a large file
check-pack refuses a record in the wrong file, a third joined file, or a missing notice, each proven by reintroducing it
both notices travel inside the pack manifest, so a copied pack still says what it is
the privacy page names both sources and states that neither is merged into our own tables
pack/ is git-ignored: 150 MB rebuilt monthly would sink the repository the way the photos nearly did
